description: React component for an admin console filter UI, including filter options, state management, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: React component class for managing and rendering filter UI with state and event handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes filter options, keys, and state; validates options.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds event listener for outside click detection.

methods.name: handleClickOutside
methods.description: Handles clicks outside the filter component to hide popover.

methods.name: togglePopover
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the filter popover.

methods.name: updateValues
methods.description: Updates filter values and marks options as modified.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Applies filters and updates filter count.

methods.name: calculateFilterCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of active filters.

methods.name: renderFilterOptions
methods.description: Renders list of filter option components.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the filter button, popover, and filter options UI.
